plugins.name: sdlc-skills
plugins.description: Full SDLC toolkit — all agents and skills in one install.

plugins.name: ba
plugins.description: Business analyst agent — turns vague ideas into user stories with acceptance criteria.

plugins.name: tech-lead
plugins.description: Tech lead agent — decomposes stories into dependency-ordered tasks, owns architecture decisions and code review.

plugins.name: project-manager
plugins.description: Project manager agent — routes tasks to developers, coordinates team progress, owns the merge gate.

plugins.name: python-dev
plugins.description: Python developer agent — implements Django, FastAPI, Flask services with TDD.

plugins.name: js-dev
plugins.description: JavaScript/TypeScript developer agent — React, Next.js, Node services with TDD.

plugins.name: ios-dev
plugins.description: iOS/Swift developer agent — SwiftUI, SwiftData, Swift Testing with TDD and no-simulator discipline.

plugins.name: qa-engineer
plugins.description: QA engineer agent — verifies features, reproduces bugs, writes E2E tests via Playwright.

plugins.name: test-automation-engineer
plugins.description: Test automation engineer agent — turns automation-ready specs into green tests inside the project's existing framework (Playwright, Cypress, pytest, JUnit, NUnit, WDIO).

plugins.name: scout
plugins.description: Codebase scout agent — maps unfamiliar repos, generates CLAUDE.md and project configuration.

plugins.name: personal-assistant
plugins.description: Personal assistant agent — email, calendar, Teams, notes, and daily briefings.

plugins.name: bugfix-workflow
plugins.description: End-to-end bugfix workflow: reproduce → root cause → fix → regression test.

plugins.name: plan-feature
plugins.description: Structured feature planning: requirements, investigation, feasibility, implementation plan.

plugins.name: implement-feature
plugins.description: Feature implementation workflow: plan review, tests, implementation, verification, delivery.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Structured code review for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Git operations: branching, commits, PRs, rebasing, cherry-picks, releases.

plugins.name: browser-verify
plugins.description: Chrome DevTools Protocol browser automation — inspect, click, screenshot, verify UI.

plugins.name: playwright-testing
plugins.description: UI/E2E test automation with Playwright MCP.

plugins.name: issue-tracking
plugins.description: Create and manage issues in GitHub, Linear, or GitLab.

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Checkpointed research workflow — trend research, topic analysis, fact-checking.

plugins.name: gathering-context
plugins.description: Cross-channel context gathering — local KB, email, Teams, web — before responding.

plugins.name: verifying-outcomes
plugins.description: Goal-backward verification — checks whether the desired outcome was actually achieved.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Per-role persistent memory — facts, preferences, decisions, and daily log as plain markdown.

plugins.name: microsoft-365
plugins.description: Microsoft 365 integration — email, Teams, calendar, SharePoint via Graph API.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault
plugins.description: Headless Obsidian vault operations — create, search, and file notes without the app.

plugins.name: efficiency-audit
plugins.description: Per-project/session/role/day and per-sub-agent AI-agent cost & efficiency, metered by ccusage — separates orchestrator overhead from dispatched sub-agents (model-aware); snapshots + before/after diffs.

plugins.name: seeding-a-project
plugins.description: Generate AGENTS.md, .agents/ project docs, and per-role memory briefings after codebase exploration.

plugins.name: session-retrospective
plugins.description: Distill past Claude Code sessions (main + sub-agent) into evidenced, ack-gated memory and workflow improvements (used by scout).

plugins.name: completing-a-task
plugins.description: Five-step task handoff protocol: commit → push → PR → comment → notify.

plugins.name: test-case-analysis
plugins.description: Execute a TMS test case end-to-end, capture stable selectors, flag defects, and emit an Automation-Friendly Spec (AFS). Used by qa-engineer. Does not write automation code.

plugins.name: test-automation-workflow
plugins.description: End-to-end test automation workflow: explore → specify → implement → review. Pluggable TMS adapters (Zephyr Scale, TestRail, Xray, Azure Test Plans, markdown).

plugins.name: vividus
plugins.description: Bootstrap, configure, and author tests for the Vividus BDD framework — JBehave-based .story files with 47+ plugins (web, REST, mobile, DB, messaging, AWS/Azure, visual, accessibility), BOM-pinned versions, suite/profile/environment configuration.

plugins.name: app-profiler
plugins.description: Manual-QA onboarding agent — profiles a web app and writes the shared app_profile.md that every manual-qa agent reads.

plugins.name: test-run-lead
plugins.description: Manual-QA run orchestrator — assembles the suite, dispatches a runner per case, triggers the report.

plugins.name: test-author
plugins.description: Manual-QA authoring agent — turns rough ideas, bug reports, or stories into formatted TC-NNN cases.

plugins.name: test-sizer
plugins.description: Manual-QA sizing agent — rates case size/complexity (S/M/L) before authoring and flags Large ones to split.

plugins.name: test-runner
plugins.description: Manual-QA execution agent — runs one case against the running app via Playwright MCP and returns a structured JSON result.

plugins.name: test-reporter
plugins.description: Manual-QA reporting agent — turns runner results into a Markdown run report.

plugins.name: xlsx-reader
plugins.description: Read .xlsx/.xls spreadsheets (test cases, checklists, requirement matrices) into Markdown tables for agent ingestion.

plugins.name: mobile-testing
plugins.description: Manual mobile-app testing via Appium / device-farm sessions — native local plus Mobitru cloud real devices.

plugins.name: product-owner
plugins.description: Product Owner discovery-lead agent (Priya) — runs intake triage, persona/outcome framing, opportunity-tree mapping, and prioritization; guards the promotion gate.

plugins.name: discovery-researcher
plugins.description: Discovery research agent (Sam) — stakeholder interviews, market/desk research, and adversarial verification of hypotheses; dispatched by product-owner.

plugins.name: intake-triage
plugins.description: Front door for raw asks — verdicts each Act Now / Plan Next / Collect More Signal / Decline-or-Defer and mints in-scope items as Problems.

plugins.name: define-personas
plugins.description: Author and maintain canonical persona cards (surface, goals, pains, JTBD, evidence) referenced by stable slug.

plugins.name: define-outcomes
plugins.description: Draft, stress-test, and ratify measurable outcome anchors (dated baseline + target + timeframe).

plugins.name: opportunity-tree
plugins.description: Maintain the opportunity–solution tree over existing artifacts — Torres gate + Olsen scoring, regenerates the outcome-tree board.

plugins.name: journeys-to-hypotheses
plugins.description: Convergence pass — classify each journey COVERED / GAP / OUT-OF-SCOPE and author missing Problem + Hypothesis stubs.

plugins.name: prioritize-bets
plugins.description: Rank incubating/promotable hypotheses (RICE default; WSJF/ICE options); confidence derived from each bet's evidence band.

plugins.name: stakeholder-interview
plugins.description: Prepare a value-of-information-ordered interview guide, or synthesize raw notes into evidence and propagate answers into hypotheses.

plugins.name: grill-decision
plugins.description: Socratic one-question-at-a-time stress-test of a decision or hypothesis, capturing outcomes inline (DEC records, edits).

plugins.name: capture-learning
plugins.description: Record a problem → outcome → lesson when a hypothesis closes or an experiment concludes.

plugins.name: discovery-status
plugins.description: Read-only discovery pipeline dashboard — gate state, what's blocked and on whom, the exact next action per item.
